title: Beko — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Beko.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "European Craft." Premium tier. Beko is part of Arceli (Koc Holding) — Europes second-largest appliance manufacturer. Their HarvestFresh technology uses colored lights to mimic the sun cycle, keeping produce fresher longer. Beko is growing in North America as a value-premium alternative with genuine European engineering.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers wanting European quality at accessible prices. Growing in Canadian and US independent dealer channels.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Beko:

• HarvestFresh technology mimics sunlight cycle for fresher produce

• Europes second-largest appliance maker — massive global scale

• European engineering at mid-range pricing

• Growing North American presence and dealer support

• EverClean filter in dishwashers for consistently clean water
